How much does a catamaran charter cost on Koh Samui? | From 20,000 THB per boat for a 2.5-hour sunset sail on the sailing catamaran Victoria (price for up to 10 guests), 36,000 THB for Blue Coco or Kia Ora (Kia Ora plus 7% VAT) and 45,000 THB for Coco Paradise. Full days and extra guests cost more; the written quote gives the exact price.
How many guests can a catamaran take on Koh Samui? | Victoria Sailing takes up to 13 guests, Blue Coco up to 25, and Kia Ora and Coco Paradise up to 45 each. For 46 to 70 guests, the Red Baron junk is the boat to choose.
Do the catamarans actually sail? | Victoria is our sailing catamaran and sets sail when there is enough wind; in light air it motors. On Blue Coco and Kia Ora it depends on the boat and the wind on the day, and Coco Paradise is a twin-engine catamaran, so if sailing matters to you, choose Victoria and tell us when you enquire.
Can we go to Ang Thong by catamaran? | Yes, on Blue Coco or Coco Paradise, as a 10-hour day (08:30–18:30) from 16 December to 31 October, with a long crossing each way. The park is closed from 1 November to 15 December, and the park fee of 300 THB per foreign adult is paid in cash.
Is food included on a catamaran charter? | Not on most programmes: soft drinks, water and usually fruit are included, and lunch or catering is quoted as an extra. On Victoria and Blue Coco you may bring your own food and drinks free of charge, and Blue Coco has a BBQ grill and a bartender.
Are catamarans good for people who get seasick? | They are the best choice: two hulls roll far less than a speedboat or a monohull. Pick a short, sheltered route such as Koh Som or the southern islands, stay on deck in the fresh air and avoid the bumpier east side in November and December.
Can we book a sunset-only catamaran charter? | Yes. Victoria and Kia Ora run 2.5-hour sunset programmes from 16:00 to 18:30, from 20,000 THB and 36,000 THB plus VAT respectively. Sunset is between about 17:55 in November and 18:45 in July.
What happens to a catamaran charter if the weather is bad? | The captain decides on the day. We first offer a sheltered route, usually the south-west islands; if the sea is unsafe we cancel, and you choose a full refund or a new date.
